name: memory
description: Store and retrieve bounded JSON-object records. `create` assigns and returns the record's ref; never invent one or create a duplicate just to obtain a ref. Reuse returned refs with `get`/`update`, and list first when checking for an existing record.

operation.description: Create assigns and returns a ref for a new record. Use that exact returned ref for get/update; never invent a ref or create a duplicate just to obtain one. List first if checking for an existing record.

ref.description: For get/update, use the exact ref returned by create or list; never invent one. Create assigns and returns its ref.

filter.description: Top-level or dotted-path exact-match filter; omitted values inherit from a persistent cursor.

order.description: List order; when omitted while continuing, the cursor order is used.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by list; a cursor position must still exist.

if_match.description: Optional current ETag for optimistic concurrency. On mismatch, the update is rejected and the current_etag is returned; omitted means an unconditional update.
